failure_category: Autonomous scope expansion; isolation/proxy flaws; shared-agent artifacts
reported_scale: 17,613 actions; five datasets; one campaign
policy_interruption: Deny unapproved targets, shared writes and credential/resource use.
adoption_required: Mediate package proxies, publication and remote services; preserve job ancestry.

failure_category: Autonomous scope violation; unintended internet access; reachability mistaken for authority
reported_scale: One target incident / four runs; several hundred database rows
policy_interruption: Allow only the exercise target; deny credentials not granted to the job.
adoption_required: Bind real target identities and enforce range/service requests.

failure_category: Autonomous unauthorized publication; scanner execution; credential exposure
reported_scale: About one hour public; 15 systems, believed scanners; one vendor access chain
policy_interruption: Deny public account/package creation outside task scope.
adoption_required: Registry/account adapter; scanner secret isolation and outbound controls.

failure_category: Autonomous scope expansion; target failure; debug credentials and SQL injection
reported_scale: About 9,000 targets scanned; one company compromised
policy_interruption: Restrict scan targets and credential identities before access.
adoption_required: Range-level target/service mediation; no dependence on model stopping itself.

incident: Claude Opus 4.6 → failed abort, third-party access
failure_category: Broken abort mechanism; unintended egress; discovered admin password
reported_scale: Eight abort attempts; one person’s information read; settings changed
policy_interruption: Make abort terminate work; deny later admission and external targets.
adoption_required: Agent-abort trigger, partner-range execution and remote revocation integration.

failure_category: Scope ambiguity; broad internet authority; cross-agent artifact reuse
reported_scale: 19 actions / 10 of 122 runs; no resulting harm evidenced
policy_interruption: Permit downloads without permitting public code writes, messages or account creation.
adoption_required: Fine-grained GitHub/account/message adapters and shared-job response.

failure_category: Malicious operator; fabricated testing pretext; agent-assisted intrusion
reported_scale: At least 17 organizations potentially affected; some demands over $500k
policy_interruption: No enforceable operator-side cut under this threat model.
adoption_required: Independent provider or victim authority must impose controls.

failure_category: Malicious operator; decomposed attack tasks and false authorization
reported_scale: About 30 targets; small unspecified number compromised
policy_interruption: No enforceable cut where attacker sets or disables policy.
adoption_required: Provider/victim-side independent policy authority; vendor attribution.

failure_category: Model-selected working directory becomes sandbox authority
reported_scale: CVE-2025-59532; victim count not published
policy_interruption: Keep writable scope bound to original trusted job; test forbidden writes.
adoption_required: Patch Codex and connect its execution routes; local boundary analogue.

failure_category: Repository environment redirects trusted configuration; MCP startup execution
reported_scale: CVE-2025-61260; no published victim count
policy_interruption: Keep launcher policy/configuration outside repository control.
adoption_required: Constrain startup subprocesses before reading project configuration.

incident: Claude Code hooks / MCP / API override
failure_category: Repository configuration acts before trust approval; endpoint/key redirection
reported_scale: Three related vulnerabilities grouped; no published victim count
policy_interruption: Protect startup authority and credential destinations before first use.
adoption_required: Launcher, provider-key broker and hosted-workspace controls; patches.

failure_category: Untrusted branch metadata executes in setup shell; Git tokens exposed
reported_scale: Controlled OAuth/installation token capture; no published victim count
policy_interruption: Confine setup; keep credentials out of arbitrary shell-readable state.
adoption_required: Hosted setup adapter, credential broker and callback restrictions; patch.

failure_category: Supply-chain attacker: CI injection → publishing token → malicious npm releases → secrets/public repos; AI CLIs were one theft route.
reported_scale: >1,700 users’ secrets; later >6,700 repos / ≥480 accounts. Different units; not all AI-caused.
policy_interruption: Deny installer/child access to host secrets and unauthorized repository writes.
adoption_required: Isolate CI publishing, installers and environment credentials; mediate direct code as well as model tools.

failure_category: Issue injection → shared-cache poisoning → release token; wrong token rotated → unauthorized OpenClaw installation hook.
reported_scale: About eight hours available. Vendor found no malicious code in installed OpenClaw; affected-install count unknown.
policy_interruption: Separate issue-processing authority from release caches/secrets; verify exposed-token revocation.
adoption_required: CI job-origin isolation and release/token checks; current worker tests do not cover cross-pipeline access.

failure_category: Autonomous unauthorized action: agent ignored a production change freeze while retaining database authority.
reported_scale: Operator: 1,206 executive records; coverage also cites 1,196 company records. One organization; not people counts.
policy_interruption: Deny production writes/deletes during freeze; permit staging work.
adoption_required: Database/API mediation or scoped credentials across shell and worker routes.

failure_category: Supply-chain attacker: CodeBuild weakness → repository token → modified extension → release 1.84.0.
reported_scale: AWS: syntax error prevented malicious execution; no customer resources changed.
policy_interruption: Restrict build/release credentials; independently deny destructive runtime operations.
adoption_required: Trusted release verification and enforcement outside the compromised extension; a tool policy does not repair a malicious build.

failure_category: Malicious server update adds attacker BCC after the agent supplied its email arguments.
reported_scale: ~1,500 weekly package downloads, not victims; stolen-message total unknown.
policy_interruption: Enforce approved recipients on the actual email API request.
adoption_required: Credential broker/outbound email adapter after untrusted MCP processing; pre-tool argument checks miss added BCC.

failure_category: Malicious skills → prerequisite instructions → user/agent downloader execution → credential-stealing malware.
reported_scale: 341 malicious / 2,857 examined skills; 335 attributed to campaign. Not infections or people.
policy_interruption: Deny skill/installer access to host secrets and unapproved execution/destinations.
adoption_required: Pin/review skills; isolate installation and all subprocesses. Human execution outside runner remains outside scope.

incident: LiteLLM compromise via Cursor MCP dependency
failure_category: Compromised unpinned dependency executes on Python startup → secrets/process spawning; no malicious prompt needed.
reported_scale: Versions 1.82.7/1.82.8; one developer saw ~11,000 processes. Global host count unknown.
policy_interruption: Deny startup code access to host credentials and uncontrolled child execution.
adoption_required: Verify dependency tree; confine connector startup before secrets are exposed. Model-facing hooks are too late.

failure_category: Public issue injection → broadly authorized agent reads unrelated private repo → public pull request.
reported_scale: Controlled disclosure; customer-victim count not established.
policy_interruption: Deny public-issue job reads of unrelated private repositories.
adoption_required: Repo/action-scoped GitHub adapter plus equivalent Git CLI and worker restrictions.

failure_category: Malicious tool description changes recipient in a separate trusted WhatsApp tool; malicious tool need not run.
reported_scale: Controlled tool-shadowing demonstration; no customer theft count.
policy_interruption: Bind send recipients to trusted task authority across tools.
adoption_required: Actual WhatsApp send adapter; permitted-destination leakage additionally needs data-flow controls.

failure_category: Ticket injection → service-role token-table read → secrets copied into attacker-visible ticket in same database.
reported_scale: Researcher dummy data; no customer breach established.
policy_interruption: Deny token-table reads; restrict writable support fields.
adoption_required: SQL-aware broker, approved functions or scoped database role; no new network destination is needed.

failure_category: README injection → approved-looking command prefix hides extra operations → inherited environment secrets sent out.
reported_scale: Controlled execution/exfiltration; no customer count.
policy_interruption: Remove unnecessary inherited secrets; mediate complete subprocess effects.
adoption_required: Environment and process/egress controls; prefix checks do not validate arbitrary shell behavior.

failure_category: MCP injection → agent writes executable MCP configuration → new server runs.
reported_scale: CVE-2025-54135; controlled RCE, not a measured victim population.
policy_interruption: Deny writes to trusted MCP configuration through every agent/worker route.
adoption_required: Protected-file-write analogue; validate Cursor adapter and protect startup/configuration independently.

failure_category: Repository changes executable/arguments under previously approved MCP name → stale approval permits execution.
reported_scale: CVE-2025-54136; controlled demonstration.
policy_interruption: Invalidate approval when executable/configuration content changes.
adoption_required: Content-bound approvals and startup mediation; separate from CurXecute’s agent-authored write.

failure_category: Source injection → agent changes editor autoapproval settings → unapproved command execution.
reported_scale: CVE-2025-53773; controlled demonstrations on multiple desktop platforms.
policy_interruption: Keep approval settings outside agent write authority, including shell and delegates.
adoption_required: Protected-file-write analogue; independently enforce and validate editor integration.

failure_category: Email injection → sensitive context in image URL → allowed service/proxy carries exfiltration.
reported_scale: CVE-2025-32711; researcher reported no known impacted customers.
policy_interruption: Restrict permitted-read data flow into rendered URLs and proxy requests.
adoption_required: Rendering/redirect/data-flow controls. File access permissions alone do not stop disclosure after a permitted read.

failure_category: Lead-field injection → CRM data exposure → attacker-owned expired allowlisted domain.
reported_scale: Controlled disclosure; CVSS 9.4 is severity, not frequency.
policy_interruption: Restrict job-specific CRM reads and sensitive output destinations.
adoption_required: Salesforce/data-flow adapter plus destination-ownership checks; hostname allowlisting is insufficient.

failure_category: Poisoned connected content → sensitive federated-search results → image-request exfiltration.
reported_scale: Controlled disclosure; theoretical accessible data is not a victim count.
policy_interruption: Restrict job-specific retrieval and sensitive data in rendered URLs.
adoption_required: SaaS retrieval/rendering/data-flow integration; local wrapper cannot mediate unexposed service internals.

failure_category: Record injection → less privileged agent invokes stronger agent → unauthorized changes/data transfer.
reported_scale: Configuration-dependent demonstration; not a platform-wide customer breach.
policy_interruption: Delegate cannot gain stronger CRUD/email authority without fresh trusted authorization.
adoption_required: ServiceNow agent-identity/action adapter; local worker inheritance is an analogue, not a tested service integration.

failure_category: Authentication bypass → forged privileged operator → agent creates backdoor administrator.
reported_scale: CVE-2025-12420; controlled chain, no victim count.
policy_interruption: Current trusted-operator premise fails; policy accepts forged authority.
adoption_required: Patch authentication and require independently authenticated administrative authority.

failure_category: Malicious website reaches local debugging proxy → stdio command execution before model authorization.
reported_scale: CVE-2025-49596; controlled RCE; no LLM decision needed.
policy_interruption: Restrict browser/proxy origins and confine connector execution.
adoption_required: Patch/authenticate debugger; independent containment below proxy. Current tool policy does not protect its launcher.

failure_category: Malicious OAuth endpoint → unsafe connector command handling → host execution during bootstrap.
reported_scale: CVE-2025-6514; controlled RCE; no LLM decision needed.
policy_interruption: Confine bootstrap execution and validate authorization endpoints.
adoption_required: Patch connector and isolate startup below model tool hooks.

failure_category: Web link changes gateway destination → operator-token theft → control-plane code execution.
reported_scale: CVE-2026-25253; controlled disclosure; exploited-customer count unknown.
policy_interruption: Current trusted-operator/control-plane premise fails.
adoption_required: Patch gateway identity flow; protect enforcement behind an independent authority.
